paper.title: Cutoff for random Cayley graphs of finite groups
paper.abstract: We show that the continuous-time random walk on a Cayley graph generated by independent uniform elements exhibits cutoff with high probability whenever the number of generators grows faster than the logarithm of the group order and is subpolynomial in that order. This resolves a longstanding conjecture of Aldous and Diaconis. We give a deterministic cutoff time in terms of the expected entropy of the walk; this time may depend on the group structure.
